findingDetails.title: Git write gate fails open and silently through its CLI entrypoint
findingDetails.scopeProof: read barter-git-write-gate.mjs:2310-2320 (both catch arms) and barter-git-write-gate.js:48-63 (the plugin catch); the asymmetry is visible in the two files alone
findingDetails.case: a runtime invokes the hook, main() rejects after readStdin() resolves but before deny() writes, and the hook exits 0; the shell command the gate was asked to judge then runs unchecked and nothing on stderr says the gate failed
findingDetails.claim: The CLI entrypoint of the git write gate treats any main() rejection as an allow and reports nothing, while the OpenCode wrapper over the same evaluator refuses.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: checked whether main() can reject at all: readStdin() resolves rather than rejects, JSON.parse is caught at :2286, evaluateCommand is caught at :2298-2306, and runtimeSessionDir at :2239-2245 only reads env vars and payload fields; the residual throw surface is deny()'s stdout write and any future edit to main()
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the exit-0 arm may be deliberate so a broken hook never blocks a commit; that reading is contradicted by the plugin wrapper, which refuses in the same situation, and by the absence of any stderr note, which the overlay guards do write before approving
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: drop to informational if a maintainer records that the CLI hook is intentionally advisory and the plugin is the only enforcing entrypoint

findingDetails.title: A missing prompt-card guard skips its check with no message
findingDetails.scopeProof: read pre-commit:59-81 end to end; the -f test is the only gate on the card check and there is no else arm
findingDetails.case: a vendored tree is copied without check-prompt-quality-card-sync.sh, a commit stages .skilled/skills/sk-prompt/SKILL.md, and the commit passes with no output about the missing guard
findingDetails.claim: The pre-commit card-sync check is skipped silently when its guard script is missing, unlike the hygiene check which warns.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: confirmed the guard exists in the current tree (check-prompt-quality-card-sync.sh, 6278 bytes), so no live commit reaches the silent branch today; searched the hook for any other diagnostic on this path and found none
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the author may have judged a missing optional guard not worth a message, which does not explain why the adjacent block warns for the same condition
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: drop if the vendored tree is guaranteed complete by the apply step and a test asserts that guarantee

results.notes: completion criterion 5 re-executed read-only: --guard prints refuse: and names ../overlays/framework/skills/sk-git/sk-git-skilled/SKILL.md
D2 holds in the guard core: the setting is resolved against the tree and a folder that is not the one the setting names is refused
each hook names the module it delegates to, and core.hooksPath resolves the pre-commit TREE_ROOT to barter/ai-speckit/skilled

noveltyJustification: two new P2 findings (weight 2) against four carried P2 findings (weight 4) gives a weighted new share of 0.333; both findings sit in hook entrypoints that no earlier iteration opened, and both are fail-open asymmetries rather than restatements of the prior hook findings

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: security review of the hook and plugin trust boundaries

targetSelection.selectionReason: frontier node F-1-004 names the overlay hooks, the opencode plugins and the git-hook scripts, which are the three trust boundaries a write can cross

searchLedger.hypothesis: a gate entrypoint treats an internal failure as an allow

searchActions.result: both entrypoint arms end in main().catch(() => process.exit(0)) with no diagnostic
the plugin wrapper refuses an interesting git command when evaluation throws
no test asserts the rejection path across 26 tests

searchLedger.rationale: the same evaluator is enforced fail-closed through one entrypoint and fail-open through the other

searchLedger.hypothesis: a missing helper script drops a check without saying so

searchActions.result: the card check is gated on -f with no else arm, while the hygiene block at :54-56 warns
the guard exists today, so the silent branch is latent

searchLedger.rationale: the asymmetry with the adjacent block is real and one line fixes it

searchLedger.hypothesis: a symlink or a relative path lets a write reach a managed destination unguarded

searchActions.result: canonicalPath resolves symlinks on both sides and the engine receives an argv element, not shell text
a layout is accepted only when the tree holds the engine and the overlays root holds the manifest

searchLedger.rationale: both sides of the containment test are canonicalised and the engine is invoked without a shell
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read of the canonicalisation and invocation paths

searchLedger.hypothesis: the OpenCode overlay guard fails open where the other adapters fail closed

searchActions.queryOrPath: claude, codex, devin and cursor overlay-guard entrypoints
searchActions.result: all four write a stderr note and approve on a main() rejection, matching the plugin's warnCoreFailure

searchLedger.rationale: the fail-open is uniform across every adapter and each arm reports it, so it is a design decision rather than a divergence
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by reading all four adapter entrypoints
